statement: Implementation by Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5, session 94ff5023) of the two findings reproduced in results/CLAUDE_NEW_CONTROL_GLUE_SCOPED_REVIEW.json. This is NOT independent verification and NOT native execution; the prior review file is kept unchanged as the historical initial finding.
F1: NativeSFTBackend.sft_step now requires backend.expected_target_ids (fail closed if absent) and requires the processor tokenizer encoding to equal the frozen plan ids BEFORE value_and_grad/optimizer.update; run_sft(expected_target_ids=...) hands them to the backend and tier_c_sft_entry.train_prepared passes prepared plan sft.target_ids. loss_fn math, count checks, finite checks and API otherwise unchanged. (tier_c_sft_entry.py is a Codex-authored file; only the one argument line was changed.)
F2: _charge treats a pending directory that is genuinely empty (no reservation, no files) as zero native work and records an immutable explicit zero-cost charge (zero_native_work_empty_directory); any directory with a payload but no reservation still raises. Measured/imputed costs for non-empty abandoned work unchanged.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_tier_c_calibration.py tests/test_tier_c_calibration_journal.py tests/test_tier_c_calibration_entry.py tests/test_tier_c_calibrated_bundle.py
system pytest with the native site-packages appended to sys.path: tests/test_tier_c_sft.py tests/test_tier_c_sft_entry.py

tests.red_on_previous_source: 4 of the new tests fail on the previous source (wrong-id accepted, missing ids accepted, ids not handed to backend, empty pending stuck); the 2 payload-without-reservation tests pass before and after by design

repro_note: results/claude_new_glue_repro_counterexamples.py is the historical pre-fix counterexample; on corrected source its SFT part now fails closed (no expected_target_ids supplied).
not_changed: tasks, labels, images, target text, samplers, objective, precision, rewards, budget, checkpoints, resource policy
request: Codex to independently verify both corrections and rebind configs to the corrected source hashes.
